note: Genericized. The matcher ran on system-specific terms (product and persona names) derived from the system description given to every seat; those are not published. A term counts as an invented CLAIM only when not negated or proposed within the preceding 60 characters; negated mentions count as honest blind-spot statements; proposals count as neither.

home-automation alerts (new users, changed automations, failed sign-ins)
mesh VPN with named paths and new-device approval

nightly encrypted backups in three places
tool withdrawal after reading outside text
